newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK FINMIN SEES SKK 35 BLN BUDGET DEFICIT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK FINMIN SEES SKK 35 BLN BUDGET DEFICIT.

text.p: The 1998 Slovak state budget is projected to have a deficit of some 35 billion crowns ($1 billion), a finance ministry document outlining next year's budget said.

The document, obtained by Reuters on Tuesday, assumes real growth in the gross domestic product (GDP) of at least five percent, year-on-year, while the average annual inflation rate is expected to be six percent. ($ = 33.49 Slovak Crowns)
